alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right. The black one asks where to eat? The blue one says I don't mind with sleepy eyes. The black one says me neither. The blue one says anything! The black one finally suggests pizza? with wide eyes, and the blue one says yes! with happy eyes and a pulse. Both settle back exactly as they started, so the film can repeat without a cut. The text stays: me and my friend picking where to eat.
